context.body: David again gathered together all the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand.

observations.body: David gathers chosen men, places the ark on a new cart, celebrates, becomes angry and afraid when Uzzah dies, and leaves the ark with Obed-Edom.
observations.label: The first ark journey stops at Uzzah’s death: textual observation

observations.body: The passage keeps David, Uzzah, Ahio, the gathered people, and Obed-Edom, Baale Judah, Perez Uzzah, and Obed-Edom’s house, gathering, transporting, celebrating, reaching, striking, fearing, and diverting visible within David's story or later memory.

payload.posture: Read 2 Samuel 6:1–11 as its own ark, house, and kingdom David setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: The source places celebration stops in death, anger, fear, and a three-month pause inside this David setting without explaining every motive, transition, or later consequence.
